research.notes: I could not find a credible match for "Preventive Consulting, LLC" in Cleveland, OH. Four searches returned only generic Cleveland consultant directories, Ohio LLC how-to pages, and pages from the Collaborative to End Human Trafficking. That nonprofit is a different organization, and nothing linked it to this vendor. The agenda also gives two names, "Preventive Consulting, LLC" and "Prevention Consulting LLC" in the item title, which adds uncertainty. I found no Ohio Secretary of State record, no website, and no SAM.gov entry. I didn't publish anything, because a wrong website or phone number would be worse than a blank. A reviewer could check the Ohio Secretary of State business search for both name spellings.
